era_context.Ancient Era: Your families share the same meeting ground; word travels quickly.
era_context.Medieval Era: The village sees who stands beside whom.
era_context.Industrial Era: The school gate is crowded with children heading home to work.
era_context.Modern Era: The journey home is where your friendship usually feels safest.
era_context.Future Era: Even a connected city has places where children feel alone.

gate.title: Someone to stand beside
gate.text: {person} is being left out by your friends. They ask whether you will still walk home together.

choices.label: Walk home together
choices.result: I stood beside {person} when it would have been easier to join the crowd.

choices.label: Offer support in private
choices.result: I comforted {person} privately, but could not bring myself to stand beside them in public.

choices.label: Follow the crowd
choices.result: I left {person} alone at the gate. We stopped taking the same way home.

reunion.title: The same familiar face
reunion.text: Years after that walk home, {person} wants to build something together: a small community project where nobody has to feel left out.

choices.label: Commit your time
choices.result: I promised {person} I would help turn our old friendship into something useful.

choices.label: Offer a smaller, honest commitment
choices.result: I told {person} what I could actually manage. We found a smaller way to work together.

choices.label: Let the invitation pass
choices.result: I let {person}'s invitation go unanswered. A good memory remained, but we drifted apart.

distance.title: A chance to speak
distance.text: You meet {person} again. They remember the gate more clearly than you expected. There is room for a conversation, if you want one.

choices.label: Own your part in it
choices.result: I apologized to {person} without asking them to pretend it never happened.

choices.label: Ask how they remember it
choices.result: I listened as {person} described the day differently from the story I had told myself.

choices.label: Keep your distance
choices.result: I avoided a difficult conversation with {person}. We went our separate ways.

repair.title: Trust takes practice
repair.text: {person} invites you to a small gathering. Showing up will matter more than another apology.

choices.label: Show up and stay
choices.result: I kept my word to {person}. Our friendship began to feel possible again.

choices.label: Explain your limits in advance
choices.result: I warned {person} before changing our plans. This time, they were not left waiting.

choices.label: Leave them waiting
choices.result: I left {person} waiting again. My apology no longer carried much weight.

opening.title: Opening day
opening.text: The project you planned with {person} is ready. They ask you to speak about why it matters.

choices.label: Tell the story and share the credit
choices.result: I thanked {person} in front of everyone. What began at a school gate became a place where others belonged.

choices.label: Help quietly behind the scenes
choices.result: I worked beside {person} without making a speech. The promise mattered more than the applause.

choices.label: Stay away
choices.result: I stayed away on the day {person} had been counting on me.

era_context.Ancient Era: Training and tools can change your place in a household.
era_context.Medieval Era: An apprenticeship can open doors that a family name alone cannot.
era_context.Industrial Era: Training offers a route away from the least secure work.
era_context.Modern Era: Course fees and materials have put pressure on your plans.
era_context.Future Era: Retraining is valuable in a world where skills become obsolete quickly.

offer.title: A little help to begin
offer.text: {person} offers money for your training and materials. It is a family loan, with a promise to repay when you can.

choices.label: Accept and promise to repay
choices.result: I borrowed from {person} to invest in my future, promising to repay them.

choices.label: Ask for advice instead of money
choices.result: I asked {person} to help me plan a path I could afford myself.

choices.label: Make your own way
choices.result: I thanked {person} and chose to fund my plans myself.

repayment.title: The promise comes due
repayment.text: {person} now needs the money back. They remember the promise that helped you get started.

choices.label: Repay the loan
choices.result: I repaid {person}. My opportunity had become a promise kept.

choices.label: Ask for two more years
choices.result: I asked {person} for more time and made a new repayment promise.

choices.label: Refuse to discuss repayment
choices.result: I refused to discuss the money I owed {person}. The debt became a family grievance.

extension.title: A second deadline
extension.text: {person} has already waited longer than planned. This is a chance to show what your renewed promise meant.

choices.label: Repay the full loan
choices.result: I finally repaid {person}. It had taken longer, but I had kept the renewed promise.

choices.label: Repay part and acknowledge the rest
choices.result: I repaid part of what I owed {person}, openly acknowledging that our agreement remained unfinished.

choices.label: Admit you cannot repay
choices.result: I admitted to {person} that I could not repay the loan. Honesty did not erase the strain.

support.title: Now they need you
support.text: {person}, who once backed your future, is facing a difficult year. They ask for help with household costs or simply someone dependable beside them.

choices.label: Help with the household costs
choices.result: I helped {person} through a difficult year, returning the support that once changed my own life.
choices.outcome: A family that helps each other

choices.label: Give your time and attention
choices.result: I made time for {person}, accepting a little strain on my own work to help them through the year.

choices.label: Keep your distance
choices.result: I had repaid the money, but chose not to stand beside {person} when they needed me.

rift.title: More than an account
rift.text: A family gathering brings you and {person} together. The old loan still hangs between you. A payment or an honest conversation could change what comes next.

choices.label: Offer a concrete gesture of repair
choices.result: I made a payment to {person} and asked to rebuild our relationship. It was a beginning, not a claim that everything was settled.

choices.label: Acknowledge the hurt without excuses
choices.result: I acknowledged what my choices had cost {person}, without demanding forgiveness.

choices.label: Avoid the conversation
choices.result: I kept away from {person}. The family learned to work around our silence.

independence.title: A different kind of support
independence.text: {person} asks how your plans turned out. They would still like to have a place in your life.

choices.label: Share what you learned
choices.result: I shared my progress with {person}. Choosing independence had not meant choosing isolation.

choices.label: Offer to teach them something
choices.result: I spent time sharing a skill with {person}. Our relationship became more equal.

choices.label: Brush off the question
choices.result: I kept my plans to myself when {person} tried to reconnect.

era_context.Ancient Era: A respected senior worker can introduce you to a patron.
era_context.Medieval Era: A craftsperson's recommendation carries weight with a guild.
era_context.Industrial Era: Experienced workers know which opportunities are worth the risk.
era_context.Modern Era: A trusted colleague offers guidance beyond the job description.
era_context.Future Era: Experienced colleagues can help you navigate a changing profession.

offer.title: An offer of guidance
offer.text: {person}, an older colleague, offers to help you improve your work. They ask you to take the effort seriously.

choices.label: Put in the work
choices.result: I took {person}'s guidance seriously and practiced the skills they showed me.

choices.label: Ask only for an introduction
choices.result: I asked {person} for an introduction before doing the work they recommended.

choices.label: Pass on the offer
choices.result: I passed on {person}'s offer of guidance.

credit.title: Who helped you get here?
credit.text: People have noticed your improvement. {person}'s contribution is easy to leave out of the story.

choices.label: Give your mentor credit
choices.result: I acknowledged how much {person} had taught me.

choices.label: Claim all the credit
choices.result: I presented my improvement as entirely my own achievement. {person} heard about it.

choices.label: Let the subject pass
choices.result: I stayed silent about {person}'s help. Our working relationship cooled.

test.title: The introduction is not enough
test.text: {person} asks whether you are ready to put in the practice behind the opportunity they offered.

choices.label: Accept the feedback and practice
choices.result: I accepted {person}'s feedback and began doing the work I had tried to skip.

choices.label: Admit this path is not for you
choices.result: I told {person} honestly that this opportunity did not suit me.

choices.label: Stop responding
choices.result: I stopped responding to {person}. The introduction led nowhere.

return.title: Guidance runs both ways
return.text: {person} asks you to share what you have learned with others. Doing so will take time from your own ambitions.

choices.label: Make time to teach
choices.result: I passed on what {person} had taught me. Their generosity reached beyond the two of us.

choices.label: Offer a smaller session
choices.result: I offered a manageable amount of help and followed through.

choices.label: Keep your knowledge to yourself
choices.result: I chose not to pass on the guidance {person} had given me.

reckoning.title: A difficult conversation
reckoning.text: {person} asks what their support meant to you. This is about trust as much as work.

choices.label: Acknowledge what you took for granted
choices.result: I apologized to {person} and gave them the credit I had withheld.

choices.label: Ask what repair would look like
choices.result: I asked {person} how I could begin repairing our working relationship.

choices.label: Dismiss their concerns
choices.result: I dismissed {person}'s concerns. They stopped investing in my progress.

era_context.Ancient Era: Households depend on several generations helping one another.
era_context.Medieval Era: Neighbors and relatives form most of the support a household can rely on.
era_context.Industrial Era: Work schedules make family care difficult to arrange.
era_context.Modern Era: Care, work, and your own wellbeing are competing for the same hours.
era_context.Future Era: New services exist, but your parent still wants a familiar person to listen.

signs.title: Small things becoming difficult
signs.text: {person} admits that everyday household tasks are becoming harder. They want a say in what happens next.

choices.label: Make a plan together
choices.result: I listened to {person} and made a care plan with them, keeping their wishes at its center.

choices.label: Take over without asking
choices.result: I took over arrangements for {person} before asking what they wanted.

choices.label: Put off the conversation
choices.result: I put off talking with {person} about the help they needed.

strain.title: A year with too few hours
strain.text: {person} needs more support. You can help with costs, make time yourself, or set a limit and explain it.

choices.label: Help cover support costs
choices.result: I helped {person} pay for practical support, making the year more manageable.

choices.label: Make regular time for them
choices.result: I made regular time for {person}, even when it complicated my own work.

choices.label: Explain your limits and plan around them
choices.result: I explained my limits to {person} and helped them plan around what I could realistically offer.

choices.label: Leave the request unanswered
choices.result: I left {person}'s request unanswered. They stopped assuming I would be there.

control.title: Their life, too
control.text: {person} says they feel managed rather than heard. They want their choices back.

choices.label: Return to the plan together
choices.result: I apologized to {person} and rebuilt the plan around their choices.

choices.label: Step back and offer help on request
choices.result: I gave {person} room to decide what help they actually wanted.

choices.label: Insist you know best
choices.result: I insisted that I knew what was best for {person}. Practical help came at the cost of trust.

gratitude.title: What they want remembered
gratitude.text: {person} asks you to spend an afternoon listening to a story from before you were born.

choices.label: Listen and write it down
choices.result: I listened to {person}'s memories and wrote them down. Caring for them also taught me who they had been.

choices.label: Share a memory of your own
choices.result: I shared a memory with {person}. We found a moment of closeness amid the practical demands.

choices.label: Keep postponing it
choices.result: I kept postponing a quiet afternoon with {person}. We spoke mostly about tasks after that.

era_context.Ancient Era: An old contact from the trade roads recognizes you.
era_context.Medieval Era: Old ties to an outlaw band are hard to keep separate from village life.
era_context.Industrial Era: An old underworld contact knows where you work now.
era_context.Modern Era: A familiar name brings back a chapter you had stopped talking about.
era_context.Future Era: An old contact can still find you despite a changed life.

return.title: An unexpected request
return.text: {person}, a contact from your earlier underworld work, asks for help getting through a difficult month. They hint that you owe them.

choices.label: Help once, with clear limits
choices.result: I helped {person} once and made clear that it bought no future favors.

choices.label: Listen without promising money
choices.result: I listened to {person}, but did not accept their claim that I owed an open-ended favor.

choices.label: Refuse the request
choices.result: I refused {person}'s request. The old connection remained uncomfortable.

boundary.title: Was once really once?
boundary.text: {person} returns with another request. They remember your help, but seem to have forgotten your limit.

choices.label: Hold the boundary calmly
choices.result: I reminded {person} of our agreement and held the boundary without humiliating them.

choices.label: Offer help finding a different path
choices.result: I helped {person} think about a more stable way forward, without becoming their source of money.

choices.label: Avoid the conversation
choices.result: I avoided another difficult conversation with {person}. The pressure of the unfinished boundary stayed with me.

pressure.title: The old story follows you
pressure.text: {person} brings up your shared past in front of someone you know. You have to decide how to respond.

choices.label: Acknowledge your past and set a limit
choices.result: I acknowledged my past without letting {person} use it to decide my future.

choices.label: Ask for a private conversation
choices.result: I asked {person} to speak privately, hoping we could agree on a way forward.

choices.label: Withdraw from the conversation
choices.result: I withdrew when {person} brought up our past. The encounter left me unsettled.

change.title: A different sort of favor
change.text: {person} asks you to help them practice for an ordinary job interview or introduction. This time the request points toward a different future.

choices.label: Help them prepare
choices.result: I helped {person} prepare for a chance at a steadier life. For once, our shared past led somewhere new.

choices.label: Encourage them honestly
choices.result: I encouraged {person} while being honest about how much help I could offer.

choices.label: Let the message go unanswered
choices.result: I let {person}'s request go unanswered. We lost the chance to know each other differently.

era_context.Ancient Era: A household's reputation often arrives before its younger members.
era_context.Medieval Era: A family name can open a door or close it.
era_context.Industrial Era: Family stories travel through workplaces and neighborhoods.
era_context.Modern Era: You are finding out which family stories other people still carry.
era_context.Future Era: Even in a changing world, old promises can outlive the people who made them.

history.title: They remember your parent
history.text: {person} knew your parent through a consequential chapter of their life. Before getting to know you, they want to tell you what they remember.

choices.label: Hear their side of the story
choices.result: I listened to {person}'s account of my parent. The family history was more complicated than a name.

choices.label: Ask to be known as yourself
choices.result: I asked {person} to get to know me through my own choices, while acknowledging our shared history.

choices.label: Avoid the family history
choices.result: I avoided talking with {person} about my parent. The old story remained between us.

choice.title: What will you carry forward?
choice.text: {person} asks whether the next generation will do things differently. There is a chance to build trust through a small shared commitment.

choices.label: Make a promise of your own
choices.result: I made a modest promise to {person}, determined to let my own actions speak.

choices.label: Be honest about your limits
choices.result: I was honest with {person} about my limits. I would not make a promise just to improve a family story.

choices.label: End the conversation
choices.result: I chose not to build a new connection with {person}.

proof.title: Your turn to be remembered
proof.text: {person} is waiting for you to keep the promise you made. Whatever your parent did, this part of the story belongs to you.

choices.label: Keep your promise
choices.result: I kept my promise to {person}. Our family name now carried a story I had written myself.

choices.label: Speak before changing the plan
choices.result: I spoke to {person} before changing our agreement. Trust survived because they were not left guessing.

choices.label: Leave them waiting
choices.result: I left {person} waiting. Another generation had added an unanswered promise to the family history.
